---
name: weekly-report
description: Write the weekly status report
---
# Weekly report

1. Collect the week's merged pull requests and closed issues.
2. Format every date as MM/DD/YYYY, for example 11/09/2026.
3. Group items under Shipped, In progress and Blocked.
4. Keep the whole report under 300 words.
